metricas.title: Metrics
metricas.subtitle: Period: last {{dias}} days
metricas.deflexion_ayuda: Issues solved with the checklist, the knowledge base, the assistant or the visual catalog, without a technician.
metricas.tiempo_ayuda: Only tickets handled by a technician.
metricas.normalizados_ayuda: Tickets for which the AI wrote a separate technical summary. The user’s original description is never modified and is shown first.
metricas.utilidad_ayuda: Of the suggestions shown, how many the recipient marked helpful. It is what calibrates how demanding suggestions are.
metricas.umbral_ayuda: How similar a solution must be to the problem before it is offered. Low suggests too much; high almost never suggests.
metricas.pendientes_ayuda: Closed tickets with a solution not yet in the knowledge base. They are added automatically every 30 min.
metricas.precision_ayuda_one: Detected category vs. the final one. Over {{count}} comparable case.
metricas.precision_ayuda_other: Detected category vs. the final one. Over {{count}} comparable cases.
metricas.ollama_caido: The local AI is not responding. The portal works the same, without AI help.
metricas.latencia_nota: Times are for this process since its last restart, not a history.
metricas.cancelados_ayuda: Not counted in the total, the channels or self-service: nobody solved them.
metricas.umbral_confianza_ayuda: Below this confidence the assistant does not guess the category: it asks the person.
metricas.lat_embedding_ayuda: Time to turn a text into a search for similar solutions.
metricas.lat_normalizacion_ayuda: Time to write the IT summary. It runs after the ticket is created: nobody waits for it.
metricas.lat_clasificacion_ayuda: Time for the assistant to suggest a category.
metricas.sin_sensores: No sensors registered in this plant.

usuarios.title: People
usuarios.subtitle: Who has access, in what state, and what they are accountable for.
usuarios.nota_flujo: Creating the account generates a single-use code. Hand it to the person: they use it to set their own password, which IT never knows. If you fill in the date of birth, they can also activate on their own with it, no code needed. And if they remember nothing, use “Activate here” with the person present.
usuarios.buscar: Search by name, email or department...
usuarios.confirmar_restablecer: Reset the password for {{nombre}}? Their current password will stop working and they will create a new one with the code generated.
usuarios.codigo_unica_vez: This code is shown only once.

usuarios.error_accion: The operation could not be completed.
usuarios.error_documento: The document could not be generated.

usuarios.corregir_numero_ayuda: While the account is not activated, the number can be corrected. The code you already handed over still works with the new number.
usuarios.fecha_ingreso_ayuda: Alternative to date of birth. Many people do not remember it.
usuarios.numero_provisional: Placeholder number · set the real one
usuarios.asistida_ayuda: Activate the account with the person present: they type their own password.
usuarios.asistida_entregue: Hand the keyboard to the person.
usuarios.asistida_nota: They type the password. You will not see it and cannot recover it later.
usuarios.no_coinciden: The two passwords do not match
usuarios.solo_asistida_ayuda: Cannot self-activate: needs a code or activation at the desk.
usuarios.fecha_nacimiento_ayuda: Lets them activate on their own, with no code. It is the date people actually remember.
usuarios.asistida_lista: Account activated. They can now sign in with their number and that password.
usuarios.numero_epp_ayuda: The four digits they use to collect their equipment. Together with the date of birth, it lets them activate on their own.
usuarios.un_factor_ayuda: Will activate with a single detail. Ask HR for their PPE number so two can be required.
usuarios.confirmar_desactivar: {{nombre}} will no longer be able to sign in. Their tickets, equipment and custody records are kept. You can reactivate the account whenever you need to.
usuarios.confirmar_reactivar: {{nombre}} will be able to sign in again with the password they already had.
usuarios.solo_bajas_nota: These people have no access to the portal. They do not appear in the normal list.
usuarios.quitar_titulo: What do you want to do with {{nombre}}?
usuarios.opcion_baja_texto: Loses access to the portal. Stays in the list under the "Deactivated" filter, and access can be restored whenever needed.
usuarios.opcion_eliminar_texto: Removed from the roster. This cannot be undone.
usuarios.eliminar_conserva: Everything they did is kept: their tickets, comments, signed custody records and documents, with their name on them.
usuarios.eliminar_borra: Their password, email, employee number —which becomes free for a new account— and verification data are erased. They will not appear in any list again.
usuarios.eliminar_equipos_one: Careful: they still hold {{count}} item. Better to return it first.
usuarios.eliminar_equipos_other: Careful: they still hold {{count}} items. Better to return them first.
usuarios.eliminado: {{nombre}} is no longer on the roster.
usuarios.copiar_manual: This browser will not copy on its own —the portal answers over HTTP—. The code is selected: press Ctrl+C.
usuarios.prioridad_alta_ayuda: When unchecked, this person cannot request high or critical priority: their tickets start as medium.
usuarios.sin_prioridad_alta_ayuda: High and critical priority were revoked for unjustified use.

importar.faltan_fechas_other: {{count}} people are missing that date. In this mode the whole file is rejected.

importar.mapeo_titulo: Tell us which column is which
importar.mapeo_detalle: The file has headers we did not recognise. Match each field to its column and carry on; nothing needs reformatting in Excel.
importar.mapeo_sugerido: The portal proposed a match. Review it: the final say is yours.
importar.mapeo_faltan: The columns marked * still need to be set.
importar.que_dato: Which detail may no one be missing?
importar.por_que_nacimiento: On activation each person is asked for the two details they actually remember: their PPE number and their date of birth. Here you choose which of them must be complete in the file; if any row is missing it, the whole file is rejected. The number in the pill is how many people would be left without that detail.
importar.repartir_detalle: Download one file per area and give it to each supervisor, so distribution does not all land on IT.

estado.title: System status
estado.subtitle: What the portal depends on, and what happens when something goes down.
estado.operativo_detalle: Tickets can be raised and worked as usual.
estado.no_operativo_detalle: A service the portal actually depends on has failed. Check the cards below.
estado.critico: If this goes down, the portal stops serving.
estado.error_cargar: System status could not be retrieved.
estado.cola_rechazados: {{n}} request(s) got no AI help because the queue was full. If this keeps rising, people are routinely going without the assistant: review IA_SALA_GENERACION or use a smaller model.
estado.cola_ayuda: An empty queue with high latencies means the model is slow. Normal latencies with a full queue means people are ahead of you. The two complaints sound the same from outside and are fixed differently.

conciencia.error_cargar: Could not load the knowledge overview.

conciencia.nivel2_ayuda: Each stage can stall on its own, and a stalled one says nothing.

atasco.indexados: Tickets are being solved but none are being indexed
atasco.procedimientos: Plenty of material and no procedure written

conciencia.sin_avisos: Nothing pending: knowledge is up to date and correctly labelled.

aviso.sin_vector: {{n}} entry(ies) with no vector: stored but invisible to every search. Happens when Ollama was down at indexing time, and does not fix itself.
aviso.categoria_dudosa: “{{titulo}}” is labelled {{etiqueta}}, but its text is about {{sugerida}}. Mislabelled, it answers questions it should not.
aviso.borradores: {{n}} draft procedure(s) waiting for review. Unpublished, they answer nobody.
aviso.temas: {{n}} proposed topic(s) waiting to be approved or dismissed.
aviso.pendientes_indexar: {{n}} solved ticket(s) with a written solution and not indexed: their knowledge does not exist for any search. Happens when Ollama was down at closing time; closing is never blocked for that.
aviso.proponer: There are enough tickets about the same problem to write a procedure. General solutions are proposed by hand: the machine drafts, a person publishes.

conciencia.sin_consultas: No queries recorded in this period yet.

origen.visual_no_arreglo: The photo did not fix it

ayuda_nodo.embedding: The question becomes a vector so it can be searched by meaning, not by words
ayuda_nodo.conocimiento: Searches solved tickets, procedures and IT documentation
ayuda_nodo.ia_local: The local model drafts over what was found. If the match was already clear, it is not called at all
ayuda_nodo.gemini: Only steps in if the local model fell short. It costs money, hence drawn apart
ayuda_nodo.respuesta: What you get, always with its source beside it

conciencia.como_leer: Size = how much is written. Line thickness = how much people ask.

conciencia.votos_mal: Most of what is suggested is not helping: worth reviewing what is written and how it is labelled.
conciencia.nada_que_revisar: Nothing to review yet: there is no knowledge written down. Start by solving tickets with a documented solution, or by writing IT documentation.
conciencia.nivel3_cifra: {{fallidas}} of {{total}} queries ({{pct}}%) could not be answered. They are the rows marked in red: that is the list of what to document.

visual.error_probar: The sentence could not be tested.
visual.cerrado_sin_ticket: Glad to hear it. No ticket needed: it is on record that this entry worked.
visual.nota_no_arreglo: I already tried what “{{titulo}}” in the visual catalog says and nothing changed.
visual.diag_no_arregla: People recognize it but it does not fix their problem. That usually means the fix is badly written, or that two different faults share this photo and it should be split into two entries.
visual.diag_no_reconocen: It gets shown often and almost nobody recognizes it as theirs. Check the photo and the phrases: it is probably matching queries that are not about this defect.
visual.quien_lo_ve: A published entry is shown to anyone in the portal who describes that defect. Before publishing, check that the screenshots carry no names, emails or anyone's personal data.

plantas.ti_global_ayuda: The IT team is global: it sees and handles every plant, with none assigned.
plantas.ayuda_persona: They will only see and choose equipment and tickets from these plants. The first one checked is the main one.
plantas.al_dejar_ti: When leaving IT, the person needs at least one plant.
plantas.planta_importacion: Plant these people are added to
plantas.subtitulo: The company's plants. IT sees them all; each person, their own.
plantas.clave_ayuda: 2 to 10 letters or digits. It goes into every ticket number (TICK-QRO-2026-0001) and cannot be changed later.
plantas.activa_ayuda: An inactive plant is no longer offered when raising tickets. Its tickets and equipment are kept.
plantas.una_sola: There is only one plant registered for now, so everyone works there. To assign several, register another plant.

qr.pista: Print it on a 4 × 2 inch label and stick it on the equipment. Scanning it opens “New ticket” with the equipment already chosen.
qr.no_copiado: Could not copy; select it by hand.
qr.equipo_ajeno: The equipment on that label is not from your plants or no longer exists. You can raise the ticket without it.

encuesta.que_fallo: What went wrong? It helps us improve.
encuesta.tasa_respuesta_ayuda: Of the tickets IT resolved in the period, how many the reporter rated.

alertas.centro_sub: What the portal detected on its own —SLA, sensors, low ratings— with its history.
alertas.vacio_detalle: Try another period, type or plant.
alertas.confirmar_todas: All pending alerts matching the type and plant filters will be marked as handled.

iot.subtitulo: Live temperature, humidity and air quality from the plant sensors.
iot.paso_broker: MQTT broker: the server's IP on the plant network, port {{puerto}}.
iot.paso_usuario: User “{{usuario}}”; the password is in the server's .env (MQTT_DISPOSITIVO_PASSWORD).
iot.paso_intervalo: At most one reading every {{segundos}} s; after {{minutos}} min without reporting, IT gets an alert.
iot.nota_sketch: The sample sketch is in esp32/sensor_portal/sensor_portal.ino. The device registers itself with its first message.
iot.vacio_detalle: They show up here on their own as soon as an ESP32 publishes its first reading.
iot.borrar_confirmar: “{{nombre}}” will be deleted with all its readings and alerts. If it publishes again it will reappear as new: to silence it, disable it.
iot.umbrales_ayuda: Empty = the plant's general threshold (shown in grey). Above it, IT gets an alert.
iot.activo_ayuda: A disabled sensor stays connected, but its readings are discarded.

imagenes.como_agregar: or drag them here, or paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V.
imagenes.formatos: JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF, up to {{mb}} MB each. They are shown below the text.
imagenes.se_guardan_al_subir: They are saved as soon as they upload.
imagenes.tipo_no_valido: {{nombre}}: only JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF are accepted.
imagenes.error_subir: The image could not be uploaded.
imagenes.error_quitar: The image could not be removed.
imagenes.error_pie: The caption could not be saved.
imagenes.algunas_no_subieron_one: Saved, but {{count}} image could not be uploaded. Edit it to try again.
imagenes.algunas_no_subieron_other: Saved, but {{count}} images could not be uploaded. Edit it to try again.
imagenes.del_ticket: From the source ticket (edit them in the ticket)
imagenes.tambien_en_kb: This ticket is already in the knowledge base: its images are shown there too.

bitacora.sub: Who did what and when, across all plants. Read-only.
bitacora.error_cargar: The audit log could not be loaded.
bitacora.vacia_detalle: Reads are not logged: only changes that affect others.

directorio.sub_ti: Company manuals, forms, drawings and spreadsheets. Each top-level folder decides who can see it.
directorio.sub_planta: Documents IT shares with your plant. Read-only.
directorio.no_encontrada: This folder does not exist or is not available to you.
directorio.error_cargar: The directory could not be loaded.
directorio.error_descargar: The file could not be downloaded.
directorio.demasiado: The upload exceeds {{mb}} MB. Upload in smaller batches.
directorio.tipo_no_permitido: File type not allowed: {{nombres}}. PDF, Office, images, CSV, TXT and ZIP are accepted.
directorio.pista_soltar: You can also drag files here. Up to {{mb}} MB per upload.
directorio.confirmar_borrar_carpeta: “{{nombre}}” and everything in it will go to the trash. It can be restored for {{dias}} days; after that it is deleted for good.
directorio.confirmar_borrar_archivo: “{{nombre}}” will go to the trash. It can be restored for {{dias}} days; after that it is deleted for good, with its versions.
directorio.sin_carpetas_ti: Create a top-level folder and choose who can see it.
directorio.carpeta_vacia_ti: Upload files or create a subfolder.
directorio.vis_plantas_largo: Staff of the plants you choose
directorio.visibilidad_nota: Subfolders inherit this visibility. Plant staff can only read.
directorio.hereda_largo: Who can see it is set by its top-level folder.
directorio.mover_nota: Once moved, the folder and its contents take the destination’s visibility.
directorio.versiones_nota: The last {{max}} are kept, including the current one. A new version must be the same type.
directorio.restaurar_antes: It is inside a folder that is also in the trash: restore that one first.
directorio.papelera_explica: Items here can be restored for {{dias}} days. After that they are deleted for good.
directorio.misma_extension: The name must keep the {{ext}} extension.

terminos.puerta_intro: {{nombre}}, before using the portal please read and accept these terms. They set the rules of use and the limits of the information the portal shows you.
terminos.caja: Text of the Terms and Conditions
terminos.vinculante_es: The Spanish version of this document is the binding one.
terminos.desplace: Scroll to the end of the document to be able to accept it.
terminos.casilla: I have read and accept the Terms and Conditions of use (version {{version}}).
terminos.cambiaron: The terms were updated while you were reading them. Please read them again to accept them.
terminos.error_aceptar: Your acceptance could not be recorded. Please try again.
terminos.error_cargar: The Terms and Conditions could not be loaded.
